Enrich person.name: Erical D. Booker
Enrich person.title: Payment Operations Manager- VP
Enrich person.summary:
I’m passionate about building a career in cybersecurity focused on compliance, where I can help organizations strengthen their security posture and meet regulatory requirements. I’ve completed the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, which provides me with hands-on experience in risk management, compliance documentation, incident response, and security frameworks.

My strengths include analyzing processes, identifying gaps, and collaborating with teams to develop solutions that enhance compliance and safeguard data. I enjoy learning new tools and approaches—whether it’s mastering log analysis, understanding network security, or keeping up with the latest regulations.

Outside of work, I enjoy solo travel, calligraphy, and roller skating. I’m learning cake decorating (precision meets creativity!) and hope to master beautiful penmanship on sweet treats soon. If you have brunch recommendations, send them my way!

Let’s connect if you’re looking for someone who brings curiosity, operational know-how, and a genuine interest in cybersecurity compliance to the table.
Enrich person.headline: Business Operations| Google Cybersecurity Certified | Proven Success in Audit, Risk, and Secure Operations
